# Publish to Pumpkin Market

Add this action after your workflow has built the plugin's `.wasm` file. It uploads that file to an
existing Pumpkin Market listing; it won't build the plugin or create a listing for you. GitHub runs
the action on Node 24, so you don't need `actions/setup-node` just for this step.

<!-- docs:begin reference -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs from package, action, extension, and component docs metadata. Run `pnpm readme`. -->

See the [action guide](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/actions/publish-to-pumpkin-market/docs/) and [API reference](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/api/actions/publish-to-pumpkin-market/) on the documentation site.
<!-- docs:end reference -->

```yaml
steps:
  - uses: filiphsps/pumpkin-plugins/actions/publish-to-pumpkin-market@publish-to-pumpkin-market-v0.0.7
    with:
      plugin-name: MyPlugin
      version: 1.2.3
      wasm-file: dist/my-plugin.wasm
      api-token: ${{ secrets.MARKET_API_TOKEN }}
      release-notes: |
        ## Changes
        - Fix plugin behavior
```

The example selects a listing by name. Name lookups read up to 10 pages of 20 Market search results
for a case-insensitive exact match. If your workflow already has the listing's numeric database ID
or public ID, use `plugin-id` for a direct lookup instead. Set exactly one of `plugin-name` and
`plugin-id`.

The tag in the example is this action's Release Please tag. Action releases are independent of your
plugin's version and of other action releases; Release Please updates the example tag when this
action gets a new release. In this repository's own release workflows, the action is called from
`./actions/publish-to-pumpkin-market`.

## Inputs

<!-- action-inputs:start -->
| Input | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin-name` | No |  | Exact listing name; set this or plugin-id, but not both |
| `plugin-id` | No |  | Numeric database ID or public ID; set this or plugin-name, but not both |
| `version` | Yes |  | Plugin version to publish, without a leading v |
| `wasm-file` | Yes |  | Path to the plugin .wasm file |
| `api-token` | No |  | Market API token with plugins:update and plugins:versions:upload scopes; required unless warn is true |
| `api-url` | No | `https://market.pumpkinmc.org` | Pumpkin Market base URL; must use https |
| `track` | No | `stable` | Release track |
| `release-notes` | No | `""` | Release notes to include in Market version metadata |
| `warn` | No | `false` | Warn instead of failing when credentials or the Market listing are unavailable |
<!-- action-inputs:end -->

## Outputs

<!-- action-outputs:start -->
| Output | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `listing-id` | Resolved numeric Market database ID |
| `listing-name` | Canonical Market listing name |
| `status` | Operation result (success or skipped) |
| `published-version` | Version successfully published to the listing |
<!-- action-outputs:end -->

Give `api-token` a GitHub secret with the `plugins:update` and `plugins:versions:upload` scopes. By
default, an empty token or a missing or unpublished listing fails the step. Set `warn: true` when
you want those cases to produce a warning and skip the upload instead. Lookup and upload errors
still fail the action. If the listing already has `version`, the action skips the upload and
reports `status: success`. When GitHub provides a step summary, the action adds a result for both
successful uploads and skipped uploads.
